entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was a beautiful, sunny day in Pa..."
entries.dialogueText: It was a beautiful, sunny day in Pales.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "From within the courtyard of Castle..."
entries.dialogueText: From within the courtyard of Castle Reinhart, near the front gate, I admired the fortress's timeless grandeur.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Most of the city center was prepare..."
entries.dialogueText: Most of the city center was prepared for the Victory Parade. Everything seemed clean, as if the war had never happened.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "However, if anyone went into the ba..."
entries.dialogueText: However, if anyone went into the back alleys, to government buildings, to residential areas, one would find sandbags lying around and bullet holes on the walls.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nothing that couldn't be fixed in d..."
entries.dialogueText: Nothing that couldn't be fixed in due time.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I wondered if I should have it rena..."
entries.dialogueText: I wondered if I should have it renamed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I found it unnecessary."
entries.dialogueText: I found it unnecessary.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I gestured to an aide and commanded..."
entries.dialogueText: I gestured to an aide and commanded him to rename the castle.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I gestured to an aide and commanded..."
entries.dialogueText: I gestured to an aide and commanded him to rename the castle.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I gestured to an aide and commanded..."
entries.dialogueText: I gestured to an aide and commanded him to rename the castle.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I gestured to an aide and commanded..."
entries.dialogueText: I gestured to an aide and commanded him to rename the castle.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The gates creaked open with a heavy..."
entries.dialogueText: The gates creaked open with a heavy groan, and I spurred my horse, following the parade.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The marching band started their son..."
entries.dialogueText: The marching band started their song. Loud cheers rose from the crowds all around me as I slowly made my way through the capital.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A child tried to approach my horse..."
entries.dialogueText: A child tried to approach my horse with a bouquet of roses. The Golden Guard held her back.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I gestured for her to approach and..."
entries.dialogueText: I gestured for her to approach and I took the bouquet. People clapped and cameras flashed.
entries.menuText: Gesture for her to approach and take the bouquet.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I disregarded her and stuck with th..."
entries.dialogueText: I disregarded her and stuck with the protocol.
entries.menuText: Disregard her and follow the protocol.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The guards grabbed him roughly and..."
entries.dialogueText: The guards grabbed him roughly and took him away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "An old man from the crowd tried to..."
entries.dialogueText: An old man from the crowd tried to approach my horse with what looked like a cane. He was swinging it over his head, swearing and cursing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Multiple guards immediately jumped..."
entries.dialogueText: Multiple guards immediately jumped on him and held him on the ground. The crowd looked disturbed and curious about what would happen.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He's just an old man. Let him go...."
entries.dialogueText: "He's just an old man. Let him go. What is he even going to do?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Straight to prison. Make sure he l..."
entries.dialogueText: "Straight to prison. Make sure he learns his place."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus looked towards me for orders."
entries.dialogueText: Titus looked towards me for orders.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Off with his head.""
entries.dialogueText: "Off with his head."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The guards let him go. He cursed an..."
entries.dialogueText: The guards let him go. He cursed and disappeared into the crowd.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few of our Morellan fighter jets..."
entries.dialogueText: A few of our Morellan fighter jets flew by close to the ground, deafening everyone.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rizian airplanes flew very close to..."
entries.dialogueText: Rizian airplanes flew very close to the ground, deafening everyone.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I rode past by tanks and mechanized..."
entries.dialogueText: I rode past by tanks and mechanized forces. The long lines of drivers and vehicles simply did not end.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I rode past by a great number of ta..."
entries.dialogueText: I rode past by a great number of tanks and mechanized vehicles.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I rode past our tanks and mechanize..."
entries.dialogueText: I rode past our tanks and mechanized forces, marveling at how such a small number of them were able to subdue the Palesian army.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The infantry column, an unending se..."
entries.dialogueText: The infantry column, an unending sea of uniforms, was awaiting my salute. There was a thunderous sound as their boots all hit the ground at the same time.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The infantry column was awaiting my..."
entries.dialogueText: The infantry column was awaiting my salute. A grand number of troops all hit the ground with their boots and saluted.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The infantry column was awaiting my..."
entries.dialogueText: The infantry column was awaiting my salute. They all hit the ground with their boots and saluted.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The infantry column was awaiting my..."
entries.dialogueText: The infantry column was awaiting my salute. They all hit the ground with their boots and saluted. Only a few hundred troops were in sight.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked at the horizon towards the..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked at the horizon towards the port of Pales.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "What a shame it was to not have the..."
entries.dialogueText: What a shame it was to not have the pride of our navy, our flagship.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Rizian fleet was covering the e..."
entries.dialogueText: The Rizian fleet was covering the entirety of the Gulf of Pales, leaving no space for any other vessel.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Rizian fleet was covering the G..."
entries.dialogueText: The Rizian fleet was covering the Gulf of Pales.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Rizian fleet -- comprising just..."
entries.dialogueText: The Rizian fleet -- comprising just a handful of battleships -- floated on the Gulf of Pales.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Each battleship deck was full of ma..."
entries.dialogueText: Each battleship deck was full of marines. I could see them saluting from a distance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could see the marines saluting fr..."
entries.dialogueText: I could see the marines saluting from a distance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The parade finally stopped and I go..."
entries.dialogueText: The parade finally stopped and I got off my horse. I patted him on the back.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In celebration, battleships cannons..."
entries.dialogueText: In celebration, battleships cannons fired into the air.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In front of me, on the grand stairs..."
entries.dialogueText: In front of me, on the grand stairs to my new palace, was Duke Reinhart. Behind him was the Throne of Pales. He was kneeling and looking at the ground.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A half-burned Palesian flag landed..."
entries.dialogueText: A half-burned Palesian flag landed on my foot. The wind must have brought it to me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I picked it up and handled it with..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked it up and handled it with care and honor, giving the flag to a nearby guard. The crowd started clapping and chanting my name.
entries.menuText: Pick it up and handle it with care and honor.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I stepped on the flag intentionally..."
entries.dialogueText: I stepped on the flag intentionally as I walked to the Duke. I heard some gasps.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I picked up the flag and ripped it..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the flag and ripped it in front of the crowd. Some began clapping and cheering, others were frowning in silence.
entries.menuText: Rip it up in front of the crowd.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I saluted our brave sailors. I was..."
entries.dialogueText: I saluted our brave sailors. I was proud of every single one of them for defeating our enemy.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I approached the defeated man befor..."
entries.dialogueText: I approached the defeated man before me.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""That's it, Your Majesty. You've wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's it, Your Majesty. You've won. Pales surrenders."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I won't be satisfied until you get..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't be satisfied until you get down and lick my boots."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He took the crown from his head and..."
entries.dialogueText: He took the crown from his head and presented it to me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I put the crown on my head. Cheers..."
entries.dialogueText: I put the crown on my head. Cheers and chants of my name ensued.
entries.menuText: Put the crown on your head.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I shoved the crown aside. It fell o..."
entries.dialogueText: I shoved the crown aside. It fell on the ground. Gasps were heard.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I hope that you are satisfied. I h..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope that you are satisfied. I have nothing else to say to you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Apologize to your King. In front o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Apologize to your King. In front of everyone."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Kiss my ring.""
entries.dialogueText: "Kiss my ring."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope you enjoy your time in pris..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you enjoy your time in prison."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You fought valiantly, Axel.""
entries.dialogueText: "You fought valiantly, Axel."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""What? That's ridiculous. We're bot..."
entries.dialogueText: "What? That's ridiculous. We're both gentlemen here--"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The guards grabbed him and made him..."
entries.dialogueText: The guards grabbed him and made him kneel down further.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I smiled as he reluctantly stuck hi..."
entries.dialogueText: I smiled as he reluctantly stuck his tongue out and licked my boot.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I won't. I--""
entries.dialogueText: "I won't. I--"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The guards grabbed him and made him..."
entries.dialogueText: The guards grabbed him and made him kneel down further.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I apologize. Your Majesty...""
entries.dialogueText: "I apologize. Your Majesty..."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Come on. There's no need for--""
entries.dialogueText: "Come on. There's no need for--"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The guards grabbed him and made him..."
entries.dialogueText: The guards grabbed him and made him kneel down further.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He kissed the ring."
entries.dialogueText: He kissed the ring.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""As did you.""
entries.dialogueText: "As did you."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""The Grand Duchy is all yours now.""
entries.dialogueText: "The Grand Duchy is all yours now."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Take good care of it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Take good care of it."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Prison? I-""
entries.dialogueText: "Prison? I-"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The guards roughly pushed Axel and..."
entries.dialogueText: The guards roughly pushed Axel and he fell to the ground. I watched as he was dragged away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The guards carefully watched him as..."
entries.dialogueText: The guards carefully watched him as he walked away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned around and looked at Pales..."
entries.dialogueText: I turned around and looked at Pales.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The rays of sun were coming down fr..."
entries.dialogueText: The rays of sun were coming down from the clouds to paint the rooftops golden.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I sat down on the Throne of Pales."
entries.dialogueText: I sat down on the Throne of Pales.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My throne."
entries.dialogueText: My throne.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Have you heard of a device called..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have you heard of a device called 'Saint Mercy'? We haven't used it since last century. But we're going to break it out of retirement especially for you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My eyes caught Major Tigris -- now..."
entries.dialogueText: My eyes caught Major Tigris -- now Colonel -- in front of the column.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus Sazon led the provincial troo..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus Sazon led the provincial troops from Brenas. He looked much older and more hardened than the last time I'd seen him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After returning from the front, the..."
entries.dialogueText: After returning from the front, the first thing he'd done was request Vina's hand in marriage.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "Now that he'd proven himself, it wa..."
entries.dialogueText: Now that he'd proven himself, it was finally time.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I'd refused."
entries.dialogueText: I'd refused.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Much appreciated. Guards, arrest t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Much appreciated. Guards, arrest this man for his many, many violent acts against Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will. Guards, arrest this man fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will. Guards, arrest this man for his many, many violent acts against Rizia."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""What? But--""
entries.dialogueText: "What? But--"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are a war criminal and you mus..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are a war criminal and you must be treated appropriately."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As you walk free today, remember t..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you walk free today, remember the mercy King Romus Toras showed you. It is more than you deserve."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have done what any monarch wou..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have done what any monarch would in your situation. You have my blessing to leave."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""One more thing. I want him torture..."
entries.dialogueText: "One more thing. I want him tortured. The so-called Duke will beg for his life."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""A war criminal? How dare y--""
entries.dialogueText: "A war criminal? How dare y--"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You will stay there until you have..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will stay there until you have repented for your infringement on my kingdom's sovereignty."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I swear to you, I've repented alre..."
entries.dialogueText: "I swear to you, I've repented already--"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Not another word from you, Reinhar..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not another word from you, Reinhart."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He shut his mouth, resigned."
entries.dialogueText: He shut his mouth, resigned.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He bowed low to the ground."
entries.dialogueText: He bowed low to the ground.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Thank you, Your Majesty. I will no..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty. I will not forget this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I rode past a small number of tanks..."
entries.dialogueText: I rode past a small number of tanks and mechanized forces.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Behind them was a massive swell of..."
entries.dialogueText: Behind them was a massive swell of soldiers from the Wehzek Armed Forces. They marched with grim-faced determination, a contrast to the jubilation of my own troops.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The gates opened with a heavy groan..."
entries.dialogueText: The gates opened with a heavy groan, revealing Rizia's interim prime minister, Daria de Rava, seated in the back of a luxurious open-top car.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "An oversized Rizian flag flapped ma..."
entries.dialogueText: An oversized Rizian flag flapped majestically in the wind, a proud emblem against its imposing stone walls.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""What a glorious day for a parade,..."
entries.dialogueText: "What a glorious day for a parade, Your Majesty. The skies seem to be celebrating with us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I nudged my horse forward until I w..."
entries.dialogueText: I nudged my horse forward until I was alongside her.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A reminder of why we keep fighting..."
entries.dialogueText: "A reminder of why we keep fighting for Rizia’s future."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A parade is just a show. The real..."
entries.dialogueText: "A parade is just a show. The real work remains ahead."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is a celebration of those who..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is a celebration of those who earned victory, not merely observed it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ah, yes, the skies. Always so supp..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, yes, the skies. Always so supportive in matters of war and statecraft."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, the heavens themselves seem t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, the heavens themselves seem to honor the sacrifices made for this victory."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria’s smile faltered, but she qui..."
entries.dialogueText: Daria’s smile faltered, but she quickly regained her composure.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""A future worth fighting for, indee..."
entries.dialogueText: "A future worth fighting for, indeed."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Halaita.""
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Indeed, Your Majesty. But even vic..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed, Your Majesty. But even victories deserve a moment in the sun."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""The skies were certainly kind to u..."
entries.dialogueText: "The skies were certainly kind to us in this war. Our brave air force helped save the day."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The gates opened with a heavy groan..."
entries.dialogueText: The gates opened with a heavy groan, revealing Rizia's interim prime minister, Manus Sazon, seated in the back of a luxurious open-top car.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I nudged my horse forward until I w..."
entries.dialogueText: I nudged my horse forward until I was alongside him.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""A glorious day for a parade, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "A glorious day for a parade, Your Majesty. The skies seem to be celebrating with us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus' smile wavered, but he quickl..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus' smile wavered, but he quickly regained his composure.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Halaita.""
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: "Of course, Your Majesty. But even v..."
entries.dialogueText: Of course, Your Majesty. But even victories deserve a moment in the sun."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Indeed, a future worth fighting fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed, a future worth fighting for."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The gates opened with a heavy groan..."
entries.dialogueText: The gates opened with a heavy groan, revealing Rizia's interim prime minister, Adarfo Sotelato, seated in the back of one of the vehicles from the King's Cars initiative.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Recently renamed The People's Car,..."
entries.dialogueText: Recently renamed The People's Car, it was simple and unadorned, embodying practicality over extravagance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The gates opened with a heavy groan..."
entries.dialogueText: The gates opened with a heavy groan, revealing Rizia's interim prime minister, Adarfo Sotelato, seated in the back of a open-top car.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I nudged my horse forward until I w..."
entries.dialogueText: I nudged my horse forward until I was alongside him.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Parades like this mask the true co..."
entries.dialogueText: "Parades like this mask the true cost of war, glossing over the sacrifices of the working class who fought and died."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perhaps, but even the working clas..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps, but even the working class needs to see that their sacrifices weren't in vain."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""War demands sacrifice.""
entries.dialogueText: "War demands sacrifice."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Sacrifice from some, profit for ot..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sacrifice from some, profit for others."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Agreed. Those who bled for this vi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Agreed. Those who bled for this victory must reap the rewards, not just the privileged few."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus' smile faltered, but he quick..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus' smile faltered, but he quickly regained his composure.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo’s gaze hardened before slowl..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo’s gaze hardened before slowly turning away.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I allowed the Prime Minister to go..."
entries.dialogueText: I allowed the Prime Minister to go ahead of me.
entries.menuText: Allow the Prime Minister to go ahead of you.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I rode alongside the Prime Minister..."
entries.dialogueText: I rode alongside the Prime Minister to stand as equals.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I had the Prime Minister follow beh..."
entries.dialogueText: I had the Prime Minister follow behind me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The sound of drums began, signaling..."
entries.dialogueText: The sound of drums began, signaling the start of the grand procession.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Loud cheers rose from the crowds al..."
entries.dialogueText: Loud cheers rose from the crowds all around as I slowly made my way through the capital.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria followed alongside me."
entries.dialogueText: Daria followed alongside me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus followed alongside me."
entries.dialogueText: Manus followed alongside me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo followed alongside me."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo followed alongside me.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Your Majesty, I agree with your or..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, I agree with your order to take Duke Reinhart into custody, but torture is a bridge too far."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Your Majesty, I agree with your or..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, I agree with your order to take Duke Reinhart into custody, but I will not condone such an inhumane punishment."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Your Majesty, I agree with your or..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, I agree with your order to take Duke Reinhart into custody, but I forbid you to have him tortured."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Torture?! Now wait a sec--"""
entries.dialogueText: "Torture?! Now wait a sec--""

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""You mean to torture me?! Now wait..."
entries.dialogueText: "You mean to torture me?! Now wait a sec--"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ah, of course. My apologies. I got..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, of course. My apologies. I got ahead of myself there."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Damned rules and their constraints..."
entries.dialogueText: "Damned rules and their constraints! But fine. I'll allow it to stand, for now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fine. You win this round.""
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. You win this round."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rizia's new prime minister signaled..."
entries.dialogueText: Rizia's new prime minister signaled to the guards, who took hold of Axel and dragged him away.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sorry for everything that happ..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry for everything that happened. But trust me, this is for the best."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My guards looked towards me for ord..."
entries.dialogueText: My guards looked towards me for orders.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria nodded, confirming the order...."
entries.dialogueText: Daria nodded, confirming the order. The guards grabbed him roughly and took him away.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""What?! Absolutely not.""
entries.dialogueText: "What?! Absolutely not."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Disregard His Majesty's order. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "Disregard His Majesty's order. The man goes free."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Prime Minister and I watched as..."
entries.dialogueText: The Prime Minister and I watched as the guards dragged him away.

entries.dialogueText: Daria's smile wavered, but she quickly regained her composure.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The skies were certainly kind to u..."
entries.dialogueText: "The skies were certainly kind to us in this war. It was our air force that helped us best Pales, after all."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I only wish Vina -- Her Highness -..."
entries.dialogueText: "I only wish Vina -- Her Highness -- had lived to see this day..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Manus. It's his fault she's dead.""
entries.dialogueText: "Manus. It's his fault she's dead."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pain mixed with anger on the Prime..."
entries.dialogueText: Pain mixed with anger on the Prime Minister's face. He could barely choke out his next words.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Fine. Do it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. Do it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A child tried to approach my horse..."
entries.dialogueText: A child tried to approach my horse with a bouquet of roses. Wruhec's Guardians held her back.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He'd returned from the front only t..."
entries.dialogueText: He'd returned from the front only to find his home province in Crown hands, his family in disarray and the House of Delegates dismantled.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He'd returned from the front only t..."
entries.dialogueText: He'd returned from the front only to find his home province in Crown hands and his family in disarray.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I almost felt bad for him."
entries.dialogueText: I almost felt bad for him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rows of polished medals gleamed acr..."
entries.dialogueText: Rows of polished medals gleamed across his chest, their ribbons crisp and colors sharp against the dark fabric of his uniform.
